title: Pac-Man Breaks at Level 256: Half the Screen Turns to Garbage

scenes.text: Half the screen turns into scrambled garbage.
The game stores its level in one byte, which only counts to 255.
Go one past it and the counter wraps around, and the game tries to draw 256 pieces of fruit.
Hidden dots sit in the garbage, so the level can never be finished.
A perfect game takes about six hours and ends at 3,333,360 points.

description:
Pac-Man crashes at level 256, and half the screen fills with garbage.
The game stores its level in a single byte that only counts to 255, so the counter wraps around and breaks the fruit drawing.
Could you play a perfect game for six hours?
